title: graphyard upgrade finds the install's own database without DATABASE_URL
description: A clean local install — its server on its own recorded Postgres cluster — upgrades to a newer commit with no DATABASE_URL in the environment: the upgrade reads the database from the install's recorded deploy settings, takes the pre-upgrade backup there, redeploys, and /healthz reports the new commit.

steps.name: Upgrade a clean install to a newer commit with no DATABASE_URL set
